title: Approvals
subtitle: Waiting on you: publishes and outreach posts before they go out, code before it lands
notifyBlocked: The browser blocked notifications. The sidebar badge still works.

publishes.emptyHistory: No publishes have been decided yet.
publishes.selectPrompt: Select a publish to review it.
publishes.draftedReview: {{drafted}} You are reviewing pre-filled text: read it, and use Edit to change anything before you approve. Nothing is sent until you approve.
publishes.approveSchedules: Approving schedules this for {{when}}; it goes to {{account}} then.
publishes.approveSends: Approving sends this to {{account}} on the next pass.
publishes.savedWaiting: Saved. It still waits for your approval.

chatTools.empty: Chat asks before every tool that needs approval. Choosing "Always approve" on a tool card, or "Always create" on a file card, lists the tool here.

held.approvedAccept: Accepted as it is on disk
held.approvedAllowAgain: Approved; nothing was applied. The same change goes through if it is made again
held.empty: No code changes are waiting. The first sweep's report and git records are under Settings → Agents → Inbound guard.
held.selectPrompt: Select a change to read what the guard found.
held.onDiskNote: This change is already on disk; the source watch found it. Approving accepts the file as it is now. Rejecting leaves it there and keeps it out of what this machine sends to others until it changes.
held.allowAgainNote: Nothing was kept to apply: this change was refused outright, so its text was not saved. Approving lets exactly this change through the next time it is made. Rejecting closes it.
held.confirmAllowAgain: Nothing is written now. Exactly this change will pass the guard the next time it is made; read every finding first.
held.confirmBlocked: The guard blocked this, not just held it. It lands only because you approve it here; read every finding first.
held.confirmApply: The change is written into this checkout now. If the file no longer reads as it did when it was held, nothing is written and the reason is shown.

outreach.postNowNote: Post now drives the agent's browser on the Agent Screen: it opens the page above, types this text and submits it, one post per click. Keep the Agent Screen open and watch until it finishes; if the screen is closed before the submit step, nothing is posted.
outreach.screenClosed: The Agent Screen is not open.
outreach.postingNow: Posting now. Watch the Agent Screen.
outreach.otherPosting: Draft #{{id}} is posting; one at a time.
outreach.selectPrompt: Select a draft to read and approve it.
outreach.approveNote: Approving posts nothing. A Reddit, YouTube or Facebook draft then waits here for Post now; the Discord bot sends a Discord draft.
